commits.message:
fix(demos): the shell opens every printed demo on its first line (rich-demos-c3k)

Review of #251: the scroll-to-top lived in one demo's wire, so rich-strip
still opened scrolled past its top. It moves to the browser shell, and the
wire's ReadingTerminal goes with it.

The demo terminal's size gets one home, examples/_browser-shell/demo-terminal.ts,
filled into the shell by vite.config.demos.ts and read by the tests that
depend on it.

At 100 columns the theme gallery rows (102 cells) and the named-ramp row
(104) were wrapped by the Console, which the fits-terminal test could not
see. The name column is now as wide as the longest name, the ramp caption
uses the section's ref(x) shorthand, and a second test checks each strip
fits as drawn at an unbounded width.

fix(demos): themes-and-color-studio opens on its first line and fits the demo terminal (rich-demos-c3k)

The browser wire scrolls xterm to the top once xterm has parsed everything
the tour printed; the Console takes its width from the host instead of a
hardcoded 120, which xterm re-wrapped mid-word in its 100 columns.

fix(demos): demo terminals draw Powerline glyphs in the Powerline face (rich-demos-4cl) (#250)

* fix(demos): demo terminals draw Powerline glyphs in the docs' Powerline face (rich-demos-4cl)

The demo shell's xterm named no font, so Powerline and Capsule joiners drew
as missing-glyph boxes. The @font-face and code font stack move out of
custom.css into code-font.css, which the theme imports and every demo shell
links; the mount passes #term's computed family to xterm.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(demos): Powerline probe re-finds its span each poll and asserts a web face, not a file's name (rich-demos-4cl)

Review (high): a repainted row stales a held CDP nodeId; the family name is
the generator's choice, not the site's; the raw U+E0B0 was invisible. Also
points the font generator's docstring at code-font.css.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(scripts): rewrap powerline-font.py docstring (rich-demos-4cl)
